title: Crestline Credit Card Points on Counter Replacements
content:
A holder's Crestline Credit Card standing adds percentage points to the coverage percentage of a replacement a Crestline store carried out at its counter and posted to a Road Hazard Protection certificate.

**Counter-replacement card points.** A holder who has a Crestline Credit Card account in status active and no late fee posted on their Crestline card accounts in the last 12 whole calendar months adds 5 points to the counter-replacement coverage percentage; a holder with an active Crestline card account and one or more such late fees in that period adds 2 points; any other holder adds no card points.

| Active Crestline Credit Card account | Late fees on the holder's Crestline card accounts, last 12 whole months | Points |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 5 |
| yes | one or more | 2 |
| no | (not relevant) | 0 |

*Hypothetical case.* A holder with an active card and no late fee adds 5 points; the same holder with one late fee eleven months ago adds 2.
